description: This file contains automated test cases for the KpiAPI class related to the Performance API in the OrangeHRM system. It defines a test class KpiAPITest that inherits from EndpointIntegrationTestCase and includes multiple test methods to validate create, update, get all, get one, and delete operations for KPI entities.

classes.name: KpiAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the KpiAPI endpoints related to performance KPIs, including create, update, retrieve, and delete operations.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a KPI using the KpiAPI.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single KPI by ID.
